SELECT p.id, p.name, p.price, p.plant_date, p.img, p.quantity, p.description, c.id AS category_id, c.name AS category_name FROM plant p LEFT JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE p.id = #{id}

SELECT p.id, p.name, p.price, p.plant_date, p.img, p.quantity, p.description, c.id AS category_id, c.name AS category_name FROM plant p LEFT JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE p.name = #{name}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO plant (name, price, plant_date, img, quantity, description, category_id) VALUES (#{name}, #{price}, #{plantDate}, #{img}, #{quantity}, #{description}, #{category.id})

SELECT p.id, p.name, p.price, p.plant_date, p.img, p.quantity, p.description, c.id AS category_id, c.name AS category_name FROM plant p LEFT JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.id ORDER BY ${sortByField} ${sortOrder}

SELECT p.id, p.name, p.price, p.plant_date, p.img, p.quantity, p.description, c.id AS category_id, c.name AS category_name FROM plant p LEFT JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.id ORDER BY p.price desc limit 1

SELECT p.id, p.name, p.price, p.plant_date, p.img, p.quantity, p.description, c.id AS category_id, c.name AS category_name from plant p left join category c on p.category_id = c.id where c.name = #{category}
SELECT c.name as categoryName ,count(p.id) as total from plant p left join category c on p.category_id = c.id group by p.category_id
select p.name, p.created_at from plant p order by p.created_at desc limit 1
